_comment: Media mapping for the Highlights panel, keyed by fixture id.
YouTube ids below were each verified through YouTube's oEmbed endpoint to
confirm the uploading channel before being added — search results claimed
several broadcaster re-uploads were 'official FIFA', and one suggested
UEFA video had already been taken down. The channel is recorded so the UI
credits the actual rights holder rather than asserting 'official'.
No video or photography is hosted here: an id points at the rights
holder's own upload, which they can withdraw at any time. Action stills go
in `images` (by moment id m0, m1... or by minute) and require a licence —
press photography of goal celebrations is agency-owned and cannot be
pulled automatically. Self-hosted files go in `clips`.
